annotations.title: Cost of an onchain FX swap

description: What a stablecoin swap on a DEX really cost, from its transaction hash: the sender's token out and token in, each priced as the currency it tracks (USDC, EURC, cUSD, KESm/cKES, cNGN, NGNm, ZARm, GHSm, XOFm, ZARP and others), measured against the independent reference for the day with a margin of error, and signed. Chains: ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, celo, robinhood. Free.

chain.description: ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, celo or robinhood.

tx.description: The swap's transaction hash, 0x followed by 64 hex characters.
